facts.description:
❗Instagram flagged my account for "suspicious activity" because I grew by 500K in just a few months.

Because of this, you might see a warning saying my account may not be real when you try to follow me.

Don't be scared to follow me. I'm a real person, and my content is worth it 🤍

You're the one holding the knife.
ㅤ
That's the part nobody wants to admit. Because if you put it down, you stop being the victim. You stop being special. You stop being the one people feel sorry for.
ㅤ
You'll have to deal with your actual life. Your work. Your dreams. Your relationships. Your health. Your future.
ㅤ
And the people who needed you to stay wounded? They'll be angry. They were never really helping you release the knife. They were just wiping away the blood.
ㅤ
The Universe can't take the pain away while you're still gripping it. But the moment you open your hand, the bandage is already there. 🤍
ㅤ
💎 Follow @pagetkagy for more on manifestation, success and quantum energetics.
ㅤ
#manifestation #quantummanifestation #quantumleaping #spiritualawakening #consciousness #abundance #lawofattraction #selfgrowthjourney

transcript.text: Take it out of my hand.
I can't do that right now.
If I pull it out while you're still gripping it,
I don't wanna cause you any more pain.
I don't wanna see what's underneath.
I don't wanna deal with the consequences.
No, then I'd have to admit that I picked up the knife,
that I'm the one holding it, that I'm hurting myself.
No, because then I won't be able to be the victim anymore.
People will stop feeling sorry for me.
I'll have to deal with my actual life,
my dreams, my relationships, my health, my future.
But if I keep holding the knife,
at least I can ask everyone for help.
And I can keep blaming you too,
because I know that you can't take the knife away.
And it's beautiful that you just admitted that.
Most people blame me for not helping them
I give you full permission to keep hurting yourself
for as long as you want,
until the day you decide to open your hand.
And when that day comes, I will catch you.
But some people will leave, won't they?
Yes, the people who still needed you to be wounded
They'll lose the role that they played in your story.
the ones who opened their hands,
the ones who learned what love feels like
Wait, so I'm allowed to keep holding the knife
